title: Karpathy Says Developers Have 'AI Psychosis'
description: Andrej Karpathy discusses developers experiencing 'AI Psychosis' - concerns about losing coding ability due to AI programming tools. Notable quote: 'I started to lose my ability to code'
author: Andrej Karpathy

title: The 'Slopacolypse' Prediction for 2026
description: Karpathy predicts 2026 will be the 'Slopacolypse', expressing concern that AI is writing most of his code and mentioning atrophying his ability to write code manually
author: Andrej Karpathy

title: Which AI Coding Tools Do Developers Actually Use at Work?
description: JetBrains Research Survey reveals top tools developers actually use: Claude Code, Cursor, JetBrains AI Assistant, Junie, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, and Google's solutions. Over 500 LLM models now available across commercial APIs and open-source releases.
author: JetBrains Research

title: Hacker News: What are your predictions for 2026?
description: HN discussion includes predictions about AI bubbles potentially popping, debate about whether LLM-coding will be worth it after accounting for downsides, and mentions that LLMs for generating photos and videos are still evolving.
author: Hacker News Community

title: GLM 5.1: 8-Hour Autonomous AI Coding Agent
description: New open-source LLM designed to work autonomously for up to 8 hours on a single task, marking a shift from 'vibe coding' to agentic AI. Part of major product launches including Cursor 3 with full agentic coding interface.
author: AI Research Community

title: Hacker News: My LLM coding workflow going into 2026
description: Discussion about practical LLM coding workflows, debate about whether AI coding tools actually provide speedups, and conversations about the division of work between developers and AI.
author: Hacker News Community

title: 84% Surge in App Submissions Driven by AI Coding Tools
description: App Store growth shows 84% surge in new app submissions attributed to AI coding tools. The LLM ecosystem has evolved dramatically with expanded model availability and agentic AI capabilities.
author: Industry Analysts

title: Hacker News: Ask HN - What developer tool do you wish existed in 2026?
description: Wishlist for AI developer tools, mentions LLM tools for CI pipelines that could propose blocking tests, and ideas for improving test selection and automation.
author: Hacker News Community

title: Prompt Injection: Biggest Threat in Deployed LLM Systems
description: New research highlights prompt injection as the biggest security threat in deployed LLM systems. Hackers can potentially change code through AI-tool queries, raising critical security challenges in generative AI coding assistants.
author: Security Researchers

title: Improving Code Generation via Small Language Model-as-a-Judge
description: ArXiv paper discusses how LLMs have shown remarkable capabilities in automated code generation. Focus on improving code generation quality using small language models as judges to evaluate code generation performance.
author: ArXiv Researchers

title: Idea First, Code Later: Disentangling Problem Solving from Code Generation
description: ArXiv paper explores disentangling problem-solving capabilities from code generation when evaluating LLMs for coding tasks, providing insights into how we should measure AI coding performance.
author: ArXiv Researchers
